mechanism_narrative: A surge in housing starts (HOUST) above 1600 units signals increased consumer confidence, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 50% of instances when HOUST > 1600.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) above 4.5% indicates tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in tightening periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An unexpected drop in unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4.0% signals a strong labor market, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days, but only if payroll employment (PAYEMS) is also increasing.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 40% of instances when UNRATE < 4.0% and PAYEMS is increasing.

mechanism_narrative: Always-on: a high and rising industrial production index (INDPRO) is indicative of a strong economy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in real disposable income (RSAFS) above $750,000 signals increased consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days, but only during monetary easing cycles.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 50% of easing cycle instances when RSAFS > 750000.

mechanism_narrative: Interaction-driven: when both FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL are rising, it signals an overheating economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 40% of instances when both FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL are rising.

mechanism_narrative: Threshold-triggered: a sudden increase in payroll employment (PAYEMS) above 150,000 signals a strong labor market, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 50% of instances when PAYEMS > 150000.

mechanism_narrative: Always-on: a high GDP growth rate (GDPC1) is indicative of a strong economy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days, but only during post-shock recovery regimes.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 40% of post-shock recovery instances when GDPC1 is high.
